description: This file implements serialization and deserialization methods for the TextMessage class within the Thunder::Core::Messaging namespace, handling text message data using frame-based buffer management.

classes.name: TextMessage
classes.description: A class representing a text message with methods to serialize and deserialize its content.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the TextMessage's text content into a buffer, returning the number of bytes written.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes text content from a buffer into the TextMessage object, returning the number of bytes read.
